text_segments.text: Nipple down BOP. Nipple up wellhead production tree and pressure test. Rig released at 0700hrs. Rig down and pack up for demobilization
FORECAST OP'S Rig down and load out rig equipment
1. PTSM: Nipple down BOP. Nipple up Production tree. Review BBS cards.
2. PTSM: Review BBS cards. Rigging down. Packing up.
[ 21 ] Install & Nipple up Xmas Tree .Pressure test connection to 3000psi for 15 mins.Test neck seals/Void 3000psi for 10 mins .Test TWCV/Tree 3000psi
18:00 [ 1 ] Rig down rig floor and TDS. Rig down mud tanks.
POB-32: Ensign - 19, CTP - 2, OICS - 4, Site Med - 1, OCS - 1, WFT - 5
RIG MGR: Simon Luke Bryant / Adam Delanie
